summary: Authenticated GPG-good signed commit 2b3080d6 on codex/phase3a1b-p6-golden-path (local ref == origin ref), diffed against RED c1e443fc, accepted plan c47927f5 and corrected contract 4f893654; GREEN docs diff is purely additive (37/0), so no frozen contract bullet was rewritten to fit the code. RED evidence (.logs/d110c-0b0a-red-c47927f5) shows 1 selected/0 passed/1 failed at the exact token after genuinely proving the seam: the retained one-call commit performed exactly one swapHead in the same call and packages/node/package.json exported neither ./creator-adoption-stage nor ./creator-adoption-recover. GREEN closes exactly that seam: creator-adoption-stage.ts exports exactly stageCreatorSuccessorAdoption+publishStagedCreatorSuccessorAdoption, creator-adoption-recover.ts exactly recoverPendingCreatorSuccessorAdoption (asserted at source and in the built-dist probe); creator-adoption-commit.ts still exports only commitCreatorSuccessorAdoption and creator-adoption.ts only verifyCreatorSuccessorAdoption. stageCandidate() was split so stage performs begin/putCachedBlob/promote/complete with no swapHead and no provider call (test asserts head identical, swapHead 0, exactly one stored Complete generation), then authenticates the durable Complete state via authenticatedStaged() (validStagedLineage requires Superseded/Adopted/Complete triple, exact base heads, exact closures, validTrustChain). The staged capability is a frozen empty object in a separate WeakMap (stagedCustody), owner-bound, deleted on consume, and is rejected by commit (intent-unavailable) and activate (capability-unavailable), cross-handle, cloned, and replayed. publishCandidate() performs exactly one old->new CAS with expectedHead=material.pendingHead and resolves ambiguity only by authenticatedTerminal reread (swapHead count asserted 1). Recovery copies both {currentAnchorDigest,epoch,objectId} tuples through exactRoomHead() from the caller's frozen input (getters and extra/missing keys rejected -> malformed-input), never from AHE/candidate bytes; it authenticates every lineage candidate through the same chain as the retained cold reopen (openCurrentAnchorTrust from pinnedGenesisAnchorDigest, cut+QC via openCreatorSuccessorTrust, inspectCreatorTrustAdvance, verifySnapshot manifest/payload/state, verifiedCatalog, generation-2 projection, predecessor latched ACL) and additionally requires trust-derived room heads to equal expectedPrevious/expectedNext and epoch+1; it mints no capability and no live material, so it cannot activate. Equivalent same-closure retries are deterministic (sort on encoded generationId, test asserts the published head equals the lexicographically smallest of two genuine Complete generations); already-new is decided by matching an authenticated candidate head before any locator ordering, and the second recovery adds zero swapHead calls; differing authenticated closures fail closed as true-fork; absent/incomplete/wrong-next/malformed cases fail closed. Retained one-call fault custody is preserved by the stageRequestFailed guard, matching the 27-row request-fault expectation (pending-old unless the swap committed). Evidence verified independently: manifest.sha256 is self-excluding and every listed hash (12 source/test paths, plan doc, both reports, ledger) reproduces; focused.json success:true 3/3 with the three current test names; retained.json success:true 86/86, 0 pending, 0 skipped, all statuses passed; 27 stashes present including the named d110c-0b0 exploratory stash; .agents/.claude/.pnpm-store untracked; no provider import or call, no examples/protocol-v3/dependency/threshold/activation/root-export change. Three P2s recorded: the ledger/plan describe the retained run as an eight-file selection while retained.json contains seven result files (numTotalTestSuites 14 = 7 files x 1 describe; the eighth file's 3 tests are proven by focused.json instead), the retained noAheMutationInVerifier governance predicate was narrowed from whole-module to the verifyCreatorSuccessorAdoption slice to admit the co-located mutating recovery kernel, and the fail-closed/decision-model test matrix is thinner than the plan's GREEN bullet. None hides a failure or weakens executed semantics.

findings.title: Retained run covered seven files, not the eight the ledger lists
findings.evidence: .logs/d110c-0b0a-green-c1e443fc/retained.json has 7 testResults entries totalling 86 tests (numTotalTestSuites 14 = 7 files x 1 describe) and does not contain tests/phase-6b-d110c-0b0a-staged-handoff-red.test.ts, yet green-ledger.md lines 18-31 list that file among 'these exact eight files' and call 14 suites 'those eight result files'; the same claim appears in the plan GREEN paragraph ('The exact retained eight-file selection passed 86/86').
findings.required_action: Evidence owner (D.110c-0b0a, carried into 0b0): correct the ledger/plan wording to state that the retained selection reported seven files/86 tests and that the eighth file's 3 tests are proved by focused.json, or re-run the retained command with the eighth file included. No re-review needed; the 86/86 and 3/3 counts themselves reproduce exactly and together cover all 89 tests at this HEAD.

findings.title: noAheMutationInVerifier narrowed from whole module to the verifier function
findings.evidence: tests/fixtures/phase-6a-v3/creator-adoption-contract.ts:1419-1428 now slices packages/node/src/creator-adoption.ts between 'export async function verifyCreatorSuccessorAdoption' (line 755) and '\nfunction coldFailure' (line 800) before applying the mutation regex; at RED the same file contained zero AHE mutation calls, while GREEN adds input.store.swapHead at creator-adoption.ts:1416 inside the co-located recovery kernel. The retained assertion (tests/phase-6a-creator-adoption-red.test.ts:307-314) therefore no longer constrains reopenCreatorSuccessorMaterial or any future non-verifier owner in that module.
findings.required_action: Owner D.110c-0b0: either relocate the pending-recovery kernel to its own internal module so the whole-module predicate can be restored, or add an explicit predicate that the reopen owner remains AHE-mutation-free. Accepted as-is here because the slice boundary fails closed (a reorder falls back to the whole file) and the intended verifier invariant is still proved; the change is disclosed in green-ledger.md line 59 and the fixture hash is in the manifest.

findings.title: Fail-closed matrix and six-step decision model thinner than the plan bullets
findings.evidence: tests/phase-6b-d110c-0b0a-staged-handoff-red.test.ts covers absent, incomplete, wrong expectedNextRoomHead (asserted only as ok:false, no kind), malformed input, true fork, equivalent retries and ambiguous CAS, but has no malformed-store, wrong expectedPreviousRoomHead, foreign-store, publish wrong-head or missing-capability case, and no tests-only decision model composing stage -> modeled pending boundary -> publish -> modeled stable boundary -> recovery as required by the GREEN acceptance bullet at docs/production-hardening/production-hardening-tdd-plan-v2.md:92866-92876.
findings.required_action: Owner D.110c-0b0, which owns the full crash matrix: add the missing fail-closed rows and the six-step composition model there.
